'''Pavel Nikolaevitch Podkolzin''' ({{langx|ru|Павел Николаевич Подкользин}}; born 15 January 1985)<ref name="Basket.ru">{{cite web |url=http://www.basket.ru/basketball/player/info/?bskplr=a2f8f031-04a5-4c99-a801-64e5feb6b402&lc=1033 |title=Российская Федерация Баскетбола - Игроки |access-date=12 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131014102929/http://www.basket.ru/basketball/player/info/?bskplr=a2f8f031-04a5-4c99-a801-64e5feb6b402 |archive-date=14 October 2013 }}</ref> is a Russian [[association football|footballer]] and former professional [[basketball]] player who played in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He was a {{convert|2.26|m|abbr=on}} tall [[center (basketball)|center]].<ref name="sovsport.ru">{{Cite web|url=https://www.sovsport.ru/football/articles/226-sm-v-karmu-na-futbolnom-pole-amkal-zakatil-shou-i-ustanovil-rekordy-kubka-1|title=226 см в карму на футбольном поле. «Амкал» закатил шоу и установил рекорды Кубка|website=Советский спорт}}</ref>

==Basketball career==
===Professional career===
Podkolzin made his debut with [[Sibirtelecom Lokomotiv Novosibirsk|Lokomotiv Novosibirsk]], in the Russian second division, during the 2001–02 season. In December 2001, he signed with Italy's [[Pallacanestro Varese|Metis Varese]], for whom he played from 2002 to 2004. He was selected by the [[Utah Jazz]] in the [[2004 NBA draft]] and promptly traded to the [[Dallas Mavericks]] for a future first-round pick in the [[2005 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Angel H. Verdejo |title=Courting an opportunity |url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/fort-worth-star-telegram-courting-an-opp/179844742/ |access-date=27 August 2025 |work=[[Fort Worth Star-Telegram]] |date=29 March 2006 |page=7D|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}{{open access}}</ref><ref name=acquire>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/mavericks/news/mavs_trade_for_Podkolzin062404.html |title=Mavs Acquire Draft Rights for Pavel Podkolzin |work=NBA.com |access-date=20 January 2009 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121105082250/http://www.nba.com/mavericks/news/mavs_trade_for_Podkolzin062404.html |archive-date=5 November 2012 }}</ref> He was originally available for selection in the [[2003 NBA Draft|previous year's draft]], but withdrew<ref name=acquire/> due to [[acromegaly]], a pituitary disorder.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nbadraft/d03/story?id=1569633|title=Diagnosis encouraging for 7-5 prospect Podkolzine|date=18 June 2003|website=ESPN.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/draft2005/index|title=ESPN.com: 2005 NBA Draft|website=www.espn.com}}</ref> Podkolzin was considered to be a high draft pick in the 2004 draft because of his size, blocking ability and strength, but he was chosen late in the draft. Podkolzin averaged 6.0 rebounds in 14.0 minutes in his first two Las Vegas Summer League Revue games.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/news/story?id=2522439|title=Buckley: Sene's the sultan of summer swats}}</ref> On 5 August 2006, he was waived by the Mavericks after appearing briefly in just six games spanning two seasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/news/story?id=2539808|title=Mavs cut loose former first-round big man Podkolzin|date=4 August 2006|website=ESPN.com}}</ref>

In 2006–07, he played in the [[Russian Basketball Super League|Russian Super League]] for [[Khimki BC]] and former team Lokomotiv Novosibirsk.

===National team career===
Podkolzin was a member of the junior Russian national basketball team that won the silver medal at the 2000 European Cadets Championship.

== Football career ==
On 19 August 2025, Podkolzin played his first professional football match, starting for [[FC Amkal Moscow|Amkal Moscow]] against [[FC Kaluga|Kaluga]] in Round 2 of the [[2025–26 Russian Cup]].<ref name="rfs.ru">{{Cite web|url=https://www.rfs.ru/cup/tournament/match/55865|title=Калуга — Амкал|website=Российский футбольный союз}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://globalsportsarchive.com/en/soccer/match/2025-08-19/fk-kaluga-vs-fk-amkal-moskva/3763845|title=FK Kaluga vs FK Amkal Moskva - August 19, 2025 - Fonbet Kubok Rossii 2025/2026 - Soccer | Global Sports Archive|website=GSA Website}}</ref><ref name="sovsport.ru"/> He became the tallest player in the history of the Russian football.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://avaz.ba/sport/nogomet/991791/pavel-podkolzin-postao-najvisi-nogometas-u-historiji|title=Pavel Podkolžin postao najviši nogometaš u historiji|date=19 August 2025|website=Dnevni avaz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sovsport.ru/football/news/eks-igrok-nba-podkolzin-stal-samym-vysokim-futbolistom-v-istorii-kubka-rossii|title=Экс-игрок НБА Подкользин стал самым высоким футболистом в истории Кубка России|website=Советский спорт}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |author1=Avi Shravan |title=7-foot-5 former Mavericks player makes history by smashing world record in another sport |url=https://www.sportskeeda.com/basketball/news-7-foot-5-former-mavericks-player-makes-history-smashing-world-record-another-sport |access-date=27 August 2025 |work=[[Sportskeeda]] |date=21 August 2025}}</ref> He played 19 minutes before being substituted.<ref name="rfs.ru"/> [[FC Amkal Moscow|Amkal Moscow]] won 1–0 and advanced to the [[2025–26 Russian Cup]] Round 3.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Два из трех медийных клубов пробились в 3-й раунд Фонбет Кубка России. "Амкал" и "Броуки" прошли дальше, 2Drots вылетели |url=https://www.sports.ru/mediafootball/1116871002-dva-iz-trex-medijnyx-klubov-probilis-v-3-j-raund-fonbet-kubka-rossii-a.html |access-date=1 September 2025 |website=Спортс’’ |language=ru}}</ref>
